assertions.title: Sidebar workspace view switching + active highlight + stats chips reflecting data

steps.action: Authenticate the assigned browser session and open /get-started.
steps.expected: The authenticated dashboard renders sidebar view buttons and stat chips.
steps.observed: The authenticated dashboard rendered Pipeline, Projects, Auth, API, and All buttons plus Projects 963 / Builds 793 / Deployments 787 / Domains 787 chips.

steps.action: Switch through Pipeline, Projects, Auth, API, and All from the sidebar.
steps.expected: Each click changes the active view, updates the URL, and shows only the relevant sections.
steps.observed: Pipeline -> repo/build/deploy/domain panels only, Projects -> project panels only, Auth -> auth panel only, API -> api panel only, All -> every section visible; the clicked button gained the active bg-blue-50 styling each time.

steps.action: Corroborate sidebar counts against the authenticated APIs.
steps.expected: Stats chips reflect actual data counts.
steps.observed: curl.exe counts matched the rendered chips exactly: 963 projects, 793 builds, 787 deployments, 787 domains.

evidence.consoleErrors: No view-switch-specific console error surfaced during the sidebar probe.
evidence.network: Authenticated count corroboration via GET /api/v1/projects (963), GET /api/v1/builds (793), GET /api/v1/deployments (787), GET /api/v1/domains (787).

assertions.title: Project creation and listing including Use Across Workflows propagation

steps.action: Open Projects view, fill the New Project form, and submit a unique project.
steps.expected: A new project is created and appears in the Projects list.
steps.observed: The UI created Panels Round3 Project 20260315-0156 and listed it at the top of the project cards with id proj_7959.

steps.action: Use project-card workflow propagation controls.
steps.expected: Use Across Workflows pushes the chosen project into repo import, source upload, artifact upload, and deployment forms.
steps.observed: Clicking Sim Project 002's Use Across Workflows changed all pipeline project selectors to Sim Project 002; clicking the new project's Use Across Workflows switched them back to Panels Round3 Project 20260315-0156 across repo import, source upload, and artifact upload/deployment selectors.

steps.action: Corroborate project persistence via API.
steps.expected: The new project exists in the backend with the submitted metadata.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/projects returned proj_7959 with slug panels-round3-20260315-0156, repo URL https://github.com/octocat/Spoon-Knife, and branch main.

evidence.consoleErrors: No project-create-specific console error surfaced during the successful create/list/propagation flow.
evidence.network: UI create persisted as GET /api/v1/projects -> {id: proj_7959, slug: panels-round3-20260315-0156, repoUrl: https://github.com/octocat/Spoon-Knife, repoBranch: main}.

steps.action: From Pipeline view, submit Repo Import for https://github.com/octocat/Spoon-Knife on branch main using the propagated project.
steps.expected: The import shows Importing..., returns an Import Accepted result card, and triggers a build.
steps.observed: The submit button showed Importing..., the panel rendered Import Accepted with build job bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6, and the sidebar/build totals increased from 790 to 791.

steps.action: Inspect the imported project's builds.
steps.expected: The builds list includes the new repo-import build.
steps.observed: The filtered builds API and builds panel both showed bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6 for proj_7959.

steps.action: Corroborate the build outcome via API.
steps.expected: The import request produces a real build record.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7959 returned bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6 with provider github, sourceRef main, repoUrl https://github.com/octocat/Spoon-Knife, and status failed after strategy detection.

evidence.consoleErrors: No import-panel-specific client exception was surfaced while the repo import was queued.
evidence.network: Repo import result card rendered Import Accepted -> build bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6; GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7959 confirmed the queued build record and GET /api/v1/builds/bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6/logs returned real clone/build status events.

assertions.title: Source bundle and WASM artifact uploads

steps.action: Upload a real zip source bundle containing noop-start.wasm through the Source Bundle Upload form.
steps.expected: The source upload shows Uploading... and then a success message with build details.
steps.observed: The Source Bundle form showed Uploading... and then rendered 'Bundle accepted. Build bld_7af35a705aa8be7d81ca29ec is in pending.' before the build completed as built.

steps.action: Upload the real noop-start.wasm file through the Prebuilt WASM Artifact form.
steps.expected: The artifact upload succeeds, shows build details, and resets the form.
steps.observed: The artifact form rendered 'Artifact ready: bld_3fbff63f83925f869fcd18f9 (wasm/wasi-command / stdout-bridge)' and reset the Source Ref field back to its default 'upload' placeholder value.

steps.action: Corroborate the resulting build records.
steps.expected: Both upload forms create real build records.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7959 returned bld_7af35a705aa8be7d81ca29ec (provider upload, sourceKind zip, buildStrategy prebuilt_wasm, status built) and bld_3fbff63f83925f869fcd18f9 (provider upload, buildStrategy uploaded_artifact, status built).

evidence.consoleErrors: No upload-form-specific client exception surfaced during the successful source/artifact submissions.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7959 confirmed source upload build bld_7af35a705aa8be7d81ca29ec (built) and artifact upload build bld_3fbff63f83925f869fcd18f9 (built).

assertions.title: Builds panel status, filtering, and log entry point

steps.action: Filter the Builds panel to proj_7959.
steps.expected: Only that project's builds remain and the stats chips update to the filtered counts.
steps.observed: The filtered panel showed Total: 3, built: 2, failed: 1 with build cards bld_3fbff63f83925f869fcd18f9, bld_7af35a705aa8be7d81ca29ec, and bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6.

steps.action: Use the filtered build cards to open View Logs.
steps.expected: Each filtered card exposes a View Logs entry point.
steps.observed: The filtered panel exposed 3 View Logs buttons, one per build card.

steps.action: Corroborate the filtered build data and logs via API.
steps.expected: The panel contents reflect actual build status/log data.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7959 returned the same 3 builds, and GET /api/v1/builds/bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6/logs returned the clone/build failure lines shown through the modal flow.

evidence.consoleErrors: No builds-panel-specific client exception surfaced while filtering the panel to proj_7959.
evidence.network: Filtered GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7959 -> 3 builds (2 built, 1 failed); GET /api/v1/builds/bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6/logs -> real log lines and status events.

assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing

steps.action: Use the propagated deployment form for proj_7959 and submit a preview deployment from bld_7af35a705aa8be7d81ca29ec with targetRef panels-round3-preview-0156 and env ROUND3=1.
steps.expected: The form shows Deploying..., then renders a deployment result card with status, domain, reachable endpoint link, and resource profile; the deployment/domain lists refresh.
steps.observed: The form showed Deploying... and rendered Deployment Created for dep_2a3ad419893f0ffa4b495c46 with status starting, domain panels-round3-20260315-0156-1.janus.run, and a resource profile, but the reachable endpoint stayed 'Not available yet'.

steps.action: Filter the Deployments panel to proj_7959.
steps.expected: The filtered list narrows to the new deployment and exposes a log entry point.
steps.observed: The filtered list narrowed to Total: 1 / starting: 1 and exposed one View Logs button for dep_2a3ad419893f0ffa4b495c46.

steps.action: Poll the deployment through the real API after the UI create succeeds.
steps.expected: The deployment reaches a running state with a runtime endpoint.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7959 kept dep_2a3ad419893f0ffa4b495c46 in status starting for repeated polls over ~40 seconds, and the related domain binding still had runtimeEndpoint: "".

evidence.consoleErrors: The authenticated browser session accumulated repeated 500 console resource errors during the long-running dashboard session while the new deployment remained stuck in starting.
evidence.network: UI create persisted as dep_2a3ad419893f0ffa4b495c46; repeated GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7959 stayed at status starting, and GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7959 returned dom_0e4198540cd5def1bd99f0dd with runtimeEndpoint empty.

assertions.issues: Deployment creation/listing is incomplete for the new project because the created deployment never progressed beyond starting and never exposed a reachable endpoint link.

steps.action: Filter the Domains panel to proj_7959.
steps.expected: The panel narrows to the new deployment's binding.
steps.observed: The filtered panel narrowed to Total: 1 / starting: 1 and rendered panels-round3-20260315-0156-1.janus.run with project, deployment, revision, type, and a fallback note telling the user to check the Deployments panel for the runtime endpoint.

steps.action: Clear the filter and inspect the general domains list.
steps.expected: The panel shows many bindings with reachable endpoint links that open in new tabs.
steps.observed: The unfiltered panel showed Total: 787 with 776 endpoint links, and sampled links rendered target=_blank (for example http://localhost:35637/).

steps.action: Corroborate the new project's domain binding via API.
steps.expected: The new deployment has a persisted domain binding.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7959 returned dom_0e4198540cd5def1bd99f0dd for dep_2a3ad419893f0ffa4b495c46 with domain panels-round3-20260315-0156-1.janus.run and status starting.

evidence.consoleErrors: No domains-panel-specific client exception surfaced while switching between filtered and unfiltered states.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7959 -> dom_0e4198540cd5def1bd99f0dd (starting, no runtimeEndpoint yet); unfiltered DOM inspection showed 776 reachable endpoint anchors with target=_blank.

assertions.title: Log modal open/filter/auto-update/copy/download/close

steps.action: Open View Logs for build bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6 from the filtered Builds panel.
steps.expected: A modal opens and shows its loading/open states.
steps.observed: The modal opened with title Build Logs - bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6 and showed the Loading logs... state before the failed-build logs were visible.

steps.action: Toggle Auto update off and switch the severity filter to Errors.
steps.expected: The modal updates the active controls and narrows the visible line count.
steps.observed: Clicking Auto update changed the checkbox to unchecked, clicking Errors reduced the chip to Visible: 1, and the modal still showed the failed build status summary.

steps.action: Use Copy, Download, and Close.
steps.expected: Copy writes the visible logs to the clipboard, Download saves a file, and Close dismisses the modal.
steps.observed: Download saved a real file under evidence/frontend-hardening/dashboard-panels-round3/downloads/3ab764be-f1b0-4634-a360-499efaf47e65 and Close dismissed the modal, but Copy raised 'Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied' and the system clipboard did not contain readable log text.

evidence.consoleErrors: agent-browser errors reported 'Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' when the Copy button was used.
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds/bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6/logs returned the 6 log lines displayed in the modal; Download produced evidence/frontend-hardening/dashboard-panels-round3/downloads/3ab764be-f1b0-4634-a360-499efaf47e65 with the expected log content.

assertions.issues: The modal's Copy control did not successfully place readable log text on the clipboard during the real browser test, even though filtering, auto-update toggle, download, and close all worked.

assertions.title: Dashboard loading states during authenticated fetches/actions

steps.action: Trigger authenticated mutations across the dashboard.
steps.expected: Submit buttons surface real in-flight labels instead of showing stale empty states.
steps.observed: The Repo Import button showed Importing..., the Source Bundle button showed Uploading..., and the Deployment button showed Deploying... during their real submissions.

steps.action: Trigger authenticated refresh/loading behaviors.
steps.expected: Refresh buttons and the log modal expose their in-flight loading labels.
steps.observed: The Builds refresh control showed Refreshing... at 50 ms after click, and the build log modal showed Loading logs... while fetching the log body.

steps.action: Inspect the resulting panels while these operations are in flight.
steps.expected: The UI does not fall back to stale empty states during active requests.
steps.observed: During import/upload/deploy/log fetches the relevant panels stayed in their active loading/result layouts rather than flashing back to empty-state copy.

evidence.consoleErrors: No loading-state-specific client exception surfaced during the successful import/upload/refresh/log-loading probes beyond the unrelated clipboard-permission failure from the modal Copy action.
evidence.network: Real authenticated in-flight states were observed while POST /api/v1/repos/import, POST /api/v1/uploads/source-bundles, POST /api/v1/deployments, GET /api/v1/builds refreshes, and GET /api/v1/builds/bld_765baae5960d975645b427e6/logs executed.

frictions.description: The assigned agent-browser session frequently became unreadable immediately after authenticated redirects/opening the dashboard unless I force-killed only the session PID from C:\Users\steve\.agent-browser\7d36c99fcfde__u2.pid and then reopened the page with a ~10 second settle wait.
frictions.resolution: Recovered only the assigned session process (not shared Janus services), re-authenticated in-browser via /api/v1/auth/session/exchange, and waited 10s before taking authenticated screenshots or DOM reads.

frictions.description: The authenticated dashboard is backed by large shared seeded data (963 projects / 793 builds / 787 deployments / 787 domains), so authenticated empty-state branches were not naturally reachable after sign-in.
frictions.resolution: Used unique project data plus project-filtered views to isolate the round3 records while still corroborating the global sidebar/domain counts via the real APIs.

blockers.description: The new deployment dep_2a3ad419893f0ffa4b495c46 never advanced beyond status starting, so its runtime endpoint stayed unavailable and its domain binding dom_0e4198540cd5def1bd99f0dd had runtimeEndpoint="" throughout the retry window.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Waited in the UI after Deploying..., refreshed the filtered deployments/domains panels, and polled GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7959 plus GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7959 for ~40 seconds; the deployment stayed starting with no endpoint.

blockers.description: The log-modal Copy action hit a browser clipboard permission denial in the real agent-browser session and did not leave readable log text on the system clipboard.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Clicked Copy repeatedly, inspected agent-browser errors, and read the Windows clipboard via Get-Clipboard/Format-Hex; Download still worked, but Copy remained blocked by writeText permission denial.

summary: Tested 9 assigned dashboard-panel assertions in the authenticated browser flow. 7 passed (VAL-FH-011, 014, 015, 016, 017, 019, 022) and 2 failed (VAL-FH-018: new deployment stayed starting with no endpoint; VAL-FH-020: Copy in the log modal failed because clipboard write permission was denied, though filter/auto-update/download/close worked).
